notes.title: Update 2.7.2 - Fighting Mannequins
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31141258/2df4a2d26844e2056abdffc9abecf2fe4bf6fcfb.gif

Now with full physics active ragdoll mannequins! They will find you and kill you!

This major update introduces full body physics for enemies. You can now fly or walk on any surface, with collisions and gravity. Double tap space to toggle flying, then left shift/space or Q/E for vertical movement. Vehicles have player collisions off so that you can still get in and drive them.

New obstacles, fences and walls have been added to sandbox mode to allow you to build a fortress and defend it from enemy mannequins. Advanced climbing AI means they will attempt to climb any physical object. Your old friendly classic mannequin will help you defeat them!

Scaling has also been added to the sandbox so that you can spawn in tiny or huge objects. Combine them for more creative building. Or just bully baby mannequins!

Changelog:

 Full physics body for enemies
 Walking, flying and gravity
 Player health and death
 Adjustable turning speed / mouse sensitivity
 New obstacles, fences and walls for sandbox
 Added scaling and turning snap on/off for sandbox
 New animated sky and better grass textures for sandbox
 Object spawner in sandbox now remembers the current page
 Object spawner in sandbox now implements undo
 New mannequin IK posing to replace old system
 Added footsteps sounds
 Vehicles now have heavier weight to be more realistic
 Improve vehicle stability
 Fix achievement for helicopter level
 Fix incorrect scale for mannequin in house level
 Add all train wipers as bonus part for consistency
 Fix disassembly timer stopping when slow motion
 Adjust sound volumes at distance
 Fix hoverboard disassembly sequencing
 Fix part finder sound carrying over to main menu
 Performance improvements
 Many other bug fixes

notes.title: Update 2.6.8 - Sandbox Mode, Bullet Holes and Ballistics
notes.notes:
Featuring true 3D bullet holes with actual depth, enhanced sounds, debris and slow motion. High performance precision calculated bullet ballistics, trajectory, penetration, deflection and tumbling. Shooting things has never been more satisfying!

With sandbox mode, allows you the freedom to build and destroy anything you want with no restrictions (other than your PC's performance!)

Build roads and skyscrapers, crash vehicles into each other, perform crazy jumps, launch an air assault, demolish buildings, and anything else you can think of!

Video shows the VR version, but you can do the same in non-VR now!
[previewyoutube=vj4gM9tMS9c;full][/previewyoutube]
[previewyoutube=2ocb6aNC7_o;full][/previewyoutube]

Full changelog:
 New true 3D bullet holes with depth
 New precision calculated bullet ballistics
 New realistic debris effects and sounds
 New smoother super slow motion for all objects
 New Sandbox Mode allows for spawning and building
 New vehicle physics with actual wheel and suspensions and better crashes
 New vehicle remote control allows for controlling multiple vehicles in sandbox
 Bicycle can now be ridden, and with new textures
 New tank gun camera allows for aiming and shooting while in the turret
 Improved grabbing in slow motion and time stop mode
 Improved smoother helicopter handling
 Add master audio volume in settings to avoid ear rape
 Fine tuned damage for all parts so they don't explode with one shot 
 Multi-threaded performance enhancements
 Room window now breaks less easily and sounds less annoying
 Lithium batteries now catch fire when shot at
 New DVD shader effects
 C4 now beeps and lights up when triggered
 Fix C4 randomly flying away when exploding
 Fix ghostly reflection in sandbox mode
 Fix Titanic not able to move
 Fix car crash colliders triggering when not moving
 Fix game being unplayable if save file corrupt (because you screwed up trying to hack the game)
 Many other bug fixes

notes.title: Update 2.6.5 - Improved Physics, Skybox and bugfixes
notes.notes:
Improved physics for large parts. Levels like the Airplane/Titanic etc. now behave more realistically without exploding out uncontrollably.
 Improved physics stability all round.
 Improved friction physics, no more infinite rolling parts
 Added new sitting mannequin. Populate your vehicles easily!
 Add a real skybox, removed literal sky box for outdoor levels
 Implement fighter jet's full flight control for Airplane level
 Improved lighting for all levels
 Upgrade to Unity 2019
 Fixed scaling issues on Skyscraper and Titanic.
 Fixed bullets hitting gun when moving forward quickly.
 Fixed level time getting reset in some cases.
 Computer GPU made easier to remove by grabbing the heatsink case
 Fixed Rice cooker cover glitching if slow motion is active
 Fixed Water heater hose detaching on start
 Fixed Flashlight reading light still turning on when disassembled
 Other minor bug fixes

notes.title: New Weapons Update! More Destruction!
notes.notes:
New awesome weapons update! Handgun, Shotgun, Assault Rifle, Grenade, C4, Rocket Launcher, and more! Experience more destruction than ever!
 New Part Finder to help you find those elusive parts to complete the level!
 New more awesome 3D explosions and shockwave effects!
 Posable mannequin which you can place in vehicles and crash and blow them up!
 X-ray glasses let you see the internal workings of objects!
 New room environment with mountain view, no more boring white rooms!
 New Custom Graphics mode with adjustable FXAA, TAA, MSAA 8x, SSAO, HDR, Bloom, and Eye adaptation (experimental)
 Settings can now be adjusted in-game
 Hundreds of other bug fixes and improvements

 Fixed the magically disappearing TV

 Fixed black parts on Sidetable in low quality mode
 Fix Water Heater hose disappearing
